title: The Three-Tailed Fox at the ancient well
summary: Zhang Xiaofan and Shi Tou cross a misty forest, where Shi Tou shows off his Aura Breaker and says the Jingang Sect is related to Tian Yin Temple. They find a woman singing by a 3,000-year-old well: she is the Three-Tailed Fox, who prays there to cure her sick big brother. She tempts Xiaofan to look into the well, and someone steps in to stop the fight. Li Xun and Yan Hong of Fen Xiang Valley arrive and say the Six-Tailed Fox stole their Red Fire Mirror; the Three-Tailed Fox says Shangguan of Fen Xiang injured her brother. She lures them into the Black Stone Cave. Bi Yao follows Xiaofan in, and Shi Tou is glad of her help. A dragon-like beast rises from the ground, Xiaofan falls during the fight, and he steadies himself with a Buddhist chant. Below, he meets the Six-Tailed Fox.
